svg.title: Training the diffusion renderers
svg.desc: Panel a trains the speech-to-audio conditioner and U-Net using target environmental audio encoded by a frozen VAE. Forward noise is predicted with MSE; the source condition is aligned to a frozen CLAP audio embedding of the target audio. Panel b trains the audio-to-speech scene conditioner, content projector and U-Net using continuous oracle features extracted from paired speech by a frozen CTC encoder. Its target speech is also VAE-encoded and noised. The global scene condition is aligned to a frozen CLAP text embedding of the paired transcript. The content LM is trained separately after target preparation; see the content LM figure.
